Good morning! So, how was the dinner at Casa Lume?
Wonderful. There were forty guests, at one long table in the garden.
Forty! Was there music?
Yes, there was a band from Lisbon. People danced until midnight.
And you? Did you dance?
No, I didn't. But I ate a lot. There were three desserts.
Three desserts! I went to a dinner in Paris last year, and there wasn't any dessert.
No dessert? That is terrible. Was the food good?
Very good, but there were only twelve people, and there was no music. Very quiet.
At Casa Lume there was a toast for the chef. It was his birthday.
That is lovely. Were there candles on the tables?
Everywhere. And the waiter remembered my name. A night to remember.
There were forty guests at one long table.
There wasn't a free table all night.
There was a band, and people danced.
It was a night to remember.

Last summer I went to my cousin's wedding in a small town in Italy. The dinner was in an old farm on a hill. There were more than a hundred guests, and there were long tables under the trees, with candles and flowers. There was no menu. The food came and came: pasta, fish, meat, cheese. There were five desserts, and I tried all of them. There was a band, of course, and everybody danced, from the grandmothers to the children. At midnight there was a toast for the couple, and there were fireworks over the hill. I didn't sleep, and I didn't care.

When I was a boy, I went to my grandmother's house every summer. It was in a small town near the sea. There was one street, and there were only twenty houses on it. There wasn't a supermarket, but there was a small market on Saturdays. There weren't many cars, so the children played in the street all day. There was a big tree in front of her house, and in the evening there were always people under it, talking. Today there is a big hotel there, and the tree is not there anymore. But in my head, the street is the same.

Last Friday I had dinner at Casa Lume. There were forty guests at one long table. There was a band from Lisbon, and people danced. There were three desserts, and I ate two. At eleven there was a toast for the chef.
